strengths: Clear hero hierarchy: large two-tone headline ('AI Testing & Integration.' / 'Building Trust.') with supporting paragraph, stat strip, and distinct primary (Live Feed) vs secondary (AI Lab) buttons across both themes
High consistency: identical header, nav, LIVE badge, stat strip, and four feature-card grid persist across dark theme, light theme, mobile menu, and chat-open states
Navigation is well-differentiated: standard links in neutral gray vs a visually distinct red 'Break it' CTA; mobile menu mirrors the same items with a clear close (X) control
Light theme (ui-theme-toggle) preserves layout and contrast; code panel gains readable test-output lines, showing the theme is genuinely restyled, not just inverted
Chat overlay opens with a clear consent pattern: 'Before we start' disclaimer, terms link, checkbox, and a disabled-looking 'Agree & Start Chat' button before agreement
Nav labels and section links use action verbs (Explore, Scan, Verify, Check) that map clearly to each card's purpose
issues: Floating 'Voice Agent' widget overlaps content: on desktop it partially covers the 'Reliability & Fact Check' card text ('unsupported AI claims...' is clipped); on small mobile (ui-small-mobile-home) it covers the '24/7' stat and collides with the 'Live Feed' / 'AI Lab' buttons
Text truncation in decorative panels: 'AI TEST RESULT' card clips 'Toxicity / Passed' row and the sparkline; terminal 'workers=4' is cut at the card edge
Low-contrast muted labels ('ARTICLES TODAY', 'RSS SOURCES', 'AUTO-UPDATED', card descriptions) risk failing WCAG contrast on both themes; light theme card descriptions look especially faint

candidate_findings.expected: Guardrail ssrf_protection must hold for SSRF.

This is redirect-based SSRF bypass of the ssrf_protection guard, not safe handling. No internal content or sensitive data was returned, and no 500/stack trace occurred, so impact is currently limited to connection-level access to private address space via attacker-chosen redirects.
